protocol.question: Does separating physical targets and identifying out-of-canvas coordinates suffice to make existing physical readouts interpretable?
protocol.selection_rule: DINO-WM T1 seed3072 for all nine tasks; LeWM and PLDM T3 seed3072 for the three PushT tasks. Fixed before diagnostic outputs. Other repeats not pooled in this targeted measurement check.
protocol.readout: Same source-group three-fold calibration as existing run; no alpha, feature projection, folds or sampled fit rows changed. Other six tasks reuse per-coordinate old readout errors.
protocol.canvas_rule: PushT centers in inclusive [0,512] for pusher and block. Paired subset requires both centers in bounds under every hidden condition at same scene/candidate/horizon; condition axis remains complete. In-bounds is not proof of visibility.
protocol.reporting: Original full aggregate preserved. Report object components, subset counts, errors and conditional-signal energy retained. A subset error decrease is distribution conditioning, not model improvement. Empty subsets remain explicit.
protocol.inference_limit: Do not subtract readout calibration error and call the difference pure model error. Do not equate readout failure with encoder information loss.
protocol.future_targets: No new physical main score or model ranking from this diagnostic. No changes to Training or Test.
